name: Work And Family
overview: Scripture teaches that both work and family are to be approached with a heart aligned to the Lord, doing all things as unto Him rather than men, which includes balancing our responsibilities in a way that honors God. The tender care of the Father toward His children models how we should value and nurture our families, while our work should be carried out wholeheartedly and with gratitude to God. This integration of devotion to God in both spheres reflects a Christ-centered life where family and labor are unified under His lordship.
